en: \[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in Slack sometimes answering a direct message with "DMs are temporarily unavailable" and dropping it when a single Slack lookup stalled; it now retries first
zh: \[Claude Tag] 修复了当单次 Slack 查询卡住时，Slack 中的 Claude 有时以 "DMs are temporarily unavailable" 回复私信并丢弃该消息的问题；现在会先重试
